title: Catalog Drawer
event: In the central atrium a long metal shelf panel unlatches and slides forward like a drawer in a catalogue: dozens of thin indexed compartments pivot out in a single smooth motion, reorienting aisles into a tight, booklike corridor.
consequence: A single oversized metal drawer remains half-open in the atrium, its lip smeared with a wet, pale residue.
nextHook: The smeared drawer lip touches the floor, leaving a damp trace the next scene reacts to.
stillPrompt: Wide, high-angle still of a real Kaufhaus atrium: an oversized metal drawer thrusts forward from a row of shelves, thin indexed compartments fanning like pages into a narrow corridor. Cool fluorescent ceiling, polished tile reflections, no text, no people. Emphasize the drawer's damp lip and the displaced floor tiles.
videoPrompt: 5-second push-in: start high over the atrium then dolly slowly toward the drawer as it slides out, panels whispering; suspension of ordinary retail geometry as compartments fold; end on the wet smear at the drawer's edge.
cameraCue: High crane push-in that settles low, revealing the drawer lip and smear last.

title: Flesh in the Drawers
event: When the drawer comes out, its inner compartments are lined with soft, pale tissue that pulses faintly; small ridged pads of flesh press against the metal, seeping a warm, saline film that beads and drips onto the tile.
consequence: A damp red-brown smear extends from the drawer onto the floor tiles, a rhythmic faint pulse visible beneath the surface.
nextHook: The pulsing smear attracts luminous droplets in the next scene, which roll along it.
stillPrompt: Tight still of the drawer interior in the familiar Kaufhaus: soft pale tissue fills the compartments, each pad slightly moving. Close focus on beads of saline fluid forming on the tissue and a fresh smear on the metal edge; keep surroundings neutral, no people, no text.
videoPrompt: 2-second macro: quivering tissue pads undulate inside the drawer; a bead grows and falls, hitting the tile and forming a shallow pulsing smear that glows faintly.
cameraCue: Macro dolly along the drawer interior ending on the droplet impact.

title: Hazard Bloom
event: Small luminous glyphs—nonverbal hazard sigils of light—bloom above the fleshy smear; where each flickers the tissue membrane briefly thins and exhales phosphorescent droplets that bead and run, creating a shimmering slick trail that snakes down an aisle.
consequence: An iridescent slick trail crosses the main corridor, linking the drawer smear to the far side of the floor and leaving tiny glyph-shaped burnlets where droplets touched metal.
nextHook: The slick trail guides and arrests pedestrian motion in the following scene, shaping the public's flow.
stillPrompt: Close still of the Kaufhaus floor: an iridescent glossy trail snakes across polished tiles, catching strip lights; tiny, non-text glyph-shaped marks scar nearby metal. No people, no logos, focus on the trace's texture and light.
videoPrompt: 3-second lateral pan: luminescent glyphs flare then fade; droplets bead and run, forming a moving slick that leads away from the smeared drawer toward the shopping aisles.
cameraCue: Low tracking shot along the slick trail, revealing its iridescence and glyph-shaped burnlets.

title: Catalogued People
event: A small group of shoppers crossing the trail slows and then freezes mid-stride as if put on a page: they assume rigid, mannequin-like poses, shopping bags slack and sagging; one bag tears and a warm, glossy seep slides onto the floor, pooling into the slick trail.
consequence: One torn shopping bag leaves a fresh puddle joining the iridescent trail and a single frozen human silhouette stands as an immobile signpost.
nextHook: A frozen shopper's collapsed bag and the joined puddle are struck by an explosive disturbance in the next scene.
stillPrompt: Wide still across the Kaufhaus main aisle: several shoppers locked in frozen poses like catalog models; a torn bag beside them leaks a glossy fluid into the glowing trail. Store architecture and lighting remain recognizably the same, no faces readable.
videoPrompt: 2-second slow reveal: begin on the slick trail and pull back to show shoppers frozen in place; one bag tears and a slow seep connects into the trail.
cameraCue: Slow pull-back from floor trace up to the frozen shoppers, then hold.

title: Shreds and Panic
event: From between reorganized shelves something erupts: a gaunt, paper-fused creature unfurls—its skin a patchwork of catalogue paper and pale flesh—and expels a violent cloud of shredded catalogue confetti that sticks to frozen shoppers and detonates sprinklers, showering the atrium with a rain of wet fibers.
consequence: Wet confetti clings to clothing and the half-open drawer slams shut under the weight of stuck fragments; overturned stanchions and a damp cascade remain.
nextHook: A pile of soaked shreds compressed on the floor becomes raw material transformed in the final scene.
stillPrompt: Dramatic still: low-angle view of a real Kaufhaus aisle as a gaunt creature of creased catalogue-paper skin and pale flesh unfurls from behind a shelf, a halo of wet confetti frozen mid-air. Shoppers smeared in fibers, sprinklers leaking. Emphasize texture and motion blur; no readable text.
videoPrompt: 5-second whip-pan: start on the closed drawer, whip toward the creature emerging, then a bursting cloud of wet catalogue shreds slams into frozen shoppers as sprinklers open, confetti raining through harsh shop lights.
cameraCue: Low handheld tilt up that jerks into a quick pan as the confetti cloud explodes, revealing the creature briefly.

title: Tokens of Consumption
event: The creature methodically compresses the soaked confetti under its ribbed chest; compacted discs—thin metallic tokens stamped with an abstract motif—pop out and roll away. Shoppers, released from their frozen poses, snatch tokens and feed them into newly formed slot-like registers; aisles fold inward into quick-sale kiosks as products are dispensed and consumed urgently.
consequence: A small pile of stamped metallic tokens rests on the tile beside a newly formed slot register, coins glinting in the halogen light.
nextHook: The pile of tokens stays visible as the Kaufhaus resumes altered circulation, hinting at the transformed economy.
stillPrompt: Tight still of the floor near a slot-register: a neat pile of thin metallic tokens stamped with an abstract glyph sits beside drenched confetti; a pair of hands reaches in to take them. The background shows collapsed aisles reconfigured into compact kiosks, maintaining Kaufhaus architecture.
videoPrompt: 2-second close shot: the creature compresses confetti; a token ejects and rolls into frame, shoppers grab it and feed it into a slot that clicks and dispenses a glossy, palely wrapped object.
cameraCue: Close, steady handheld at token level that watches a token eject and get picked up, then pulls back slightly to show transformed kiosks.
